activity_summary: You looked at the three boats on the step, where you had said they would stay. A scrap of reed was still on one hull. The door was shut. No one was in the frame.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Looked once, and left them there.

entities.name: the three bark boats
entities.context: Mentioned in Three boats on the step
